visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee wearing a white sweater speaks energetically to the camera. The background is a soft grey studio. Numerous social media comments from users asking for a group buy are floating around him. He holds a pink handheld beauty device. (2) The scene cuts to a montage of various skincare products from Medicube, including serums, creams, and facial masks laid out on a clean surface. Text labels such as 'PDRN', 'CICA', and 'DEEP' appear next to the product lines. (3) A close-up shot shows the digital screen of the pink beauty device, followed by the man demonstrating the device on his cheek. He points to his glowing skin. (4) A rapid sequence shows screen captures of various Instagram posts and influencers, including a celebrity holding the device, indicating its global popularity. (5) The man is seen in multiple indoor settings, such as a bathroom and living room, using the device with different light modes (green, blue, red). He wears a headband in one scene. (6) The man sits on a sofa with a vast array of skincare products and mask packs spread out in front of him on a low table. A promotional graphic with pricing and a countdown appears.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator (77Boss) and 1 male friend appearing briefly in the final sofa scene.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a male in his 30s with short black hair and a styled goatee. He wears a white long-sleeved sweater and later a denim jacket and a grey hoodie.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video shifts between a minimalist grey studio background, a modern living room with a grey sofa, and a brightly lit bathroom with a circular vanity mirror.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a fast-paced electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the speaker lists different product types. (3) 'Pop' and 'ding' sound effects are used frequently to emphasize the appearance of variety-style text on screen. (4) The speaker's pitch rises when mentioning the discount price, followed by a 'camera shutter' SFX during the influencer montage. (5) The mix is very dense, with nearly continuous speech overlapping the upbeat music, maintaining a high-arousal promotional atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Social Proof -> Product Demonstration -> Scarcity Tactic -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement designed to re-launch a group buy for the Medicube AGE-R Booster Pro. It uses social proof (floating comments and influencer testimonials), direct product benefits (modes for whitening, repair, and anti-aging), and a sense of urgency (limited units and time) to encourage immediate purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed explanation of features, and a clear call to action with a discount price and link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a 'variety show' editing style typical of social media marketing in East Asia, with dense text overlays and frequent sound effects to keep viewer attention.
